combinations.readout: mechanical and thermal pain thresholds (von Frey, Hargreaves) at POD28

combinations.evidence_quote: based on this, the inhibition of PPAR γ activity using GW9962 reversed the GDPD3 knockdown effect, lowering mechanical and thermal pain thresholds at POD28 without significant changes in behavioral outcomes at POD0, 7 and 14 of modelling, these results suggest that the modulatory effect of GDPD3 deficiency on nociception is mediated through the PPAR γ pathway (Figs. 7B–D).

combinations.evidence_quote: However, GW9962 (inhibitor of PPARγ) reversed the effect of GDPD3 on macrophagic polarization, indicating that the modulating effect of GDPD3 deficiency on macrophagic polarization was through PPAR γ pathway (Fig. 6E, F).
